22092 -> 22083. Nine down, of which four are this change and five predate it.

Measured with the CI command, `eslint . --format=json` summed over `errorCount`, on a tree
with nothing uncommitted besides this change and node_modules at the lockfile pins
(eslint 10.6.0, prettier 3.9.4, eslint-plugin-prettier 5.5.6, eslint-plugin-simple-import-sort
12.1.1).

The change fixes the product-documents kanban previewer, which still read the attachment
through `ir_attachment_id` after product.document folded into documents.document. It now reads
an overridable `attachment` getter, and sale_pdf_quote_builder gains a record and a renderer so
quotation.document keeps pointing at its own field. Those two new files are prettier-clean, and
running the formatter over quotation_document_kanban_view.js took it from 4 errors to 0. That is
the whole of this change contribution: -4.

The other five were already banked. The same command over the four touched files at HEAD reads 4
where the working tree reads 0, so HEAD totals 22087 against a floor of 22092 and the gate was
red on mainline before this branch existed. eslint has no cross-file rule enabled here, so the
per-file measurement attributes the split exactly.
